name: pi-skills
description: Skills-first Pi package with permanent Semantic-SQL memory, bioinformatics and R skills, detachable tasks, system-R RLM, and goals.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:readme
scripts.test: npm run test:package && npm run test:background-tasks && npm run test:context-budget && npm run test:completions && npm run test:workbench && npm run test:memory && npm run test:rlm && npm run test:expert-discipline && npm run test:mandatory-skills && npm run test:anti-slop && npm run test:codex-web-search && npm run test:biomedical-evidence
scripts.test:background-tasks: rm -rf .background-task-test-build && tsc --target ES2023 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --types node --rootDir . --outDir .background-task-test-build scripts/test_background_tasks.ts vendor/pi-background-tasks/src/core/common.ts vendor/pi-background-tasks/src/core/registry.ts vendor/pi-background-tasks/src/extension.ts && node .background-task-test-build/scripts/test_background_tasks.js; status=$?; rm -rf .background-task-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:context-budget: rm -rf .context-budget-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .context-budget-test-build --declaration false && node --test .context-budget-test-build/context-budget/context-budget.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .context-budget-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:completions: rm -rf .completion-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .completion-test-build --declaration false && node --test .completion-test-build/completions/completions.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .completion-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:workbench: rm -rf .workbench-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .workbench-test-build --declaration false && node --test .workbench-test-build/goals/*.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .workbench-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:memory: rm -rf .memory-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .memory-test-build --declaration false && cp extensions/memory/*.sql .memory-test-build/memory/ && node --test .memory-test-build/memory/memory.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .memory-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:rlm: rm -rf .rlm-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .rlm-test-build --declaration false && cp extensions/rlm/repl-worker.mjs .rlm-test-build/rlm/ && node --test .rlm-test-build/rlm/rlm.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .rlm-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:expert-discipline: rm -rf .expert-discipline-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .expert-discipline-test-build --declaration false && node --test .expert-discipline-test-build/expert-discipline/expert-discipline.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .expert-discipline-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:mandatory-skills: rm -rf .mandatory-skills-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .mandatory-skills-test-build --declaration false && node --test .mandatory-skills-test-build/mandatory-skills/mandatory-skills.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .mandatory-skills-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:anti-slop: rm -rf .anti-slop-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .anti-slop-test-build --declaration false && node --test .anti-slop-test-build/anti-slop/anti-slop.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .anti-slop-test-build; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; Rscript scripts/test_anti_slop.R
scripts.test:codex-web-search: rm -rf .codex-web-search-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .codex-web-search-test-build --declaration false && node --test .codex-web-search-test-build/codex-web-search/codex-web-search.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .codex-web-search-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:biomedical-evidence: rm -rf .biomedical-evidence-test-build && tsc --noEmit false --outDir .biomedical-evidence-test-build --declaration false && node --test .biomedical-evidence-test-build/biomedical-evidence/biomedical-evidence.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .biomedical-evidence-test-build; exit $status
